## UnTestOperator type

The upstream UnTestOperator domain: exact named tokens, the Go zero value, and explicitly validated unnamed uint32 values. Constants shared by upstream families retain their shared numeric identity.

**Signature:**

  | 0
  | typeof TsBlckSp
  | typeof TsCharSp
  | typeof TsDirect
